bc_main_wall_12.blurb: Main Wall is the central one of three walls at Electric Edge, a roadside crag in the Sea to Sky corridor north of Whistler, sitting at roughly 1,570 feet. It holds eight climbs: five sport routes and three trad lines. Most fall in the 5.10 range, with two at 5.11 and one at 5.12, so it suits climbers already comfortable on 5.10 or harder rather than beginners. The face catches sun in the morning, and it is where the largest share of the crag's routes have been cleaned up. The rest of Electric Edge has easier lines if you want a warm-up nearby.
